description: Source code for a RequestsDelete tool class that performs HTTP DELETE requests with dynamic URL and query parameter handling, including schema parsing and request execution.

classes.name: RequestsDeleteTool
classes.description: A class extending DynamicStructuredTool to perform DELETE HTTP requests with dynamic URL and query parameter handling based on provided schema.

methods.name: createRequestsDeleteSchema
methods.description: Creates a Zod schema for DELETE request query parameters, parsing schema string if provided.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Executes the DELETE request with URL and query parameters processed according to schema, returning response text truncated to maxOutputLength.
